unmeasured.why: Theme and accent colour are web-level settings (web/ApplyTheme, thememanager); CanvasContent1 carries no theme field, so no page save can set them.

The control-data shape for section backgrounds (image, gradient) is not known to formwork; a guessed shape would only re-measure unknown-key survival. To learn it, set one in the editor on a sandbox page and run the extract paste-in.
formwork knows no per-section spacing key in the canvas model; if this tenant's editor exposes one, extract a page that uses it to learn the shape.
This probe reads persisted bytes only. Whether the text web part renders an inline style, and whether the editor honours the section variants, is a browser question outside this readback.

unmeasured.why: Adding a page to the site navigation is a navigation-node write (web/Navigation/QuickLaunch), not a page save; this lane writes pages only. No FINDINGS.md row page.navigation.* exists, so the DSL refuses a navigation key.
HasUniqueRoleAssignments is READ on every page (persisted.*.permissions); breaking inheritance (BreakRoleInheritance) is a permission write this lane does not attempt.

The banner is written two ways only (the item's URL field by MERGE, the page model's BannerImageUrl by SavePageAsDraft). Any other banner-bearing key of the page entity is listed under pageKeys and not written, because its shape is not assumed.
This lane reads persisted fields only; whether the layout, banner or promoted state renders as such is a browser question outside this readback.
